source: actual catalog/definition instance and asset identity
actual view.MapSubScene.SceneGUID and NavigationMetadata.AuthoredSubSceneGuid, which branch won

publicApiLimits: ResolvedSceneHash,ResolvedSectionPath.HybridReferenceId,SceneSectionReferencedUnityObjects are internal in this pinned package
EditorPlayModeLoader.LoadState and instance query methods on RuntimeContentManager are internal; no public per-instance loader identity enumeration established
EntityScenesPaths/artifact-path helper is internal. Do not silently replace supported observations with reflection/private-field probes
RuntimeContentManager.GetObjectLoadingStatus/GetObjectValue are public object-cache queries, not proof of the internal Editor instance-handle join; do not load/retain an ID just to observe it
GlobalObjectId/AssetDatabase persisted identity may be unresolved for serialized/cloned nonpersistent objects; preserve null rather than infer identity from names
SceneManager.sceneCount/GetSceneManagerSetup alone may omit preview objects. Observe existing objects/scenes without calling GetCompanionScene, opening preview scenes or loading assets
invariants: Warmup vs normal tuple compare actual GUID+section+artifact+reference object identities; distinguish equalGUID/differentinstances from wrongsource
Original pre-run scene/roots remain exactly present; every extra root must retain identity and first appearance phase, not be excused or deleted
No schema-normalized ownership baseline or wider root allowance; observed2->4 remains failure
All native/reference/causal observations below remain NULL until an authorized Windows checkpoint run
No package-private mutation, root deletion, preview close, asset load, Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets, scene changes or global resets in observer

repairDecision.if: Owner starts duplicate or unmatched real scene loads
repairDecision.minimalCandidate: Correct that one existing game owner load/release pairing using supported SceneSystem lifecycle; retain DestroyMetaEntities and normal scene ownership. Requires actual ownership proof and separate source/compile/native validation.

repairDecision.if: Warmup resolves different actualsource/section/artifact than normal
repairDecision.minimalCandidate: Correct only the binding/preparation selection under existing policy; preserve Campaign geometry/budgets. Matching GUID alone still insufficient. Do not expand baseline to swallow additional roots.

repairDecision.if: Same exact artifact loaded per-instance produces retained source objects after legitimate ownership release
repairDecision.minimalCandidate: No supported roots-only reclaim repair demonstrated in this source. Need narrowly reviewed package/lifecycle fix or supported production reference reuse, with explicit authority and exact identity before/after proof; no manual deletion or private reset.

A separately reviewed warmup recipe matching normal async path can test timing/reference correspondence. It is diagnostic until zero extra roots and full native gates pass, and is not assumed to eliminate per-instance retention.

acceptance: Source hypotheses/observation recipe only; no repair installed, compiler/native run, sourcefit, mission acceptance or new failure waiver.
